_doc: Tel'aran'rhiod. In the World of Dreams what you imagine is, if your will holds: these are the things a dreamer can do there, each on a key (key = the QWERTY position; a character may rebind them in profile.dream_keys). Every one spends Will (the mind's stamina: tune.will, coming back at tune.regen a second once you have done nothing dreamlike for tune.rest seconds, faster standing still). kind shift: you are simply somewhere else (where = behind the one you look at | back | aim). kind bolt: a thing imagined and thrown. kind chain: binds the one you look at after `wind` seconds unless they are gone from the spot or Deny it. kind pit: the ground under the aim point turns on those standing there. kind wall: a wall across your front that stops what flies. kind deny: for `window` seconds whatever dream-thing reaches you is unmade, and the one who made it is shaken (tune.shaken seconds without the dream, and tune.rebuke Will lost). Only activities with dream: true allow any of it.

shift_behind.name: Step behind
shift_behind.blurb: You are behind the one you are looking at.

shift_back.name: Step away
shift_back.blurb: You are seven paces back from where you stood.

shift_aim.name: Step there
shift_aim.blurb: You are where you were looking.

deny.name: Deny
deny.blurb: It is not so. What reaches you in the next instant is unmade.

dream_chains.name: Chains
dream_chains.blurb: They hold the one you look at, unless they are gone first.

dream_pit.name: The ground turns
dream_pit.blurb: Where you look, the earth takes hold of whoever stands on it.

dream_wall.name: A wall
dream_wall.blurb: Stone across your front: nothing thrown comes through.
